svg.title: The velocity response against the crew tool's 80,000-character ceiling
svg.desc: Two windows measured over the mounted reckon checkout. For each, three bars: the whole payload with the project-lane-day cells, the summary with the cells withheld, and the repaired default of three aggregate tables plus a cell count. A vertical line marks the 80,000-character ceiling that mcp_budget.bound_response enforces. Both whole payloads and the pinned window's cells-withheld summary cross the line; both defaults sit well under it. A note below the axis shows that asking for the cells without a limit still crosses the line: the default plus one default-size page is 80,308 over the two-day window and 138,848 over the pinned one, which is what the receipt's limit suggestion is for.
svg.text: The velocity payload against the crew tool's response ceiling
mcp_budget.DEFAULT_RESPONSE_CEILING = 80,000 characters, measured over the mounted reckon checkout at each window's derived head
cells withheld — 122,758, still past the ceiling
Asking for the cells without a limit can still cross the line: the default plus one default-size page of them is
80,308 characters over the two-day window and 138,848 over the pinned one — a page comes back as its own
response, so limit is the narrowing that gets each window under the line. The receipt that reports the
overflow names limit and fields — both of which this branch accepts.
